# Alen

> > Alen manufactures premium HEPA air purifiers with smart filtration technology for homes and businesses, featuring the BreatheSmart lineup with medical-grade H13 filters and lifetime warranty options.

Alen specializes in True HEPA air purification systems designed for various room sizes, from compact bedrooms to large commercial spaces. All products feature advanced filtration, smart sensors, and replacement filter subscriptions, with HSA/FSA eligibility on select models.

## Key Topics

- HEPA Filtration (H13 Medical-Grade)
- BreatheSmart Air Purifiers
- Forever Guarantee
- Smart Air Quality Monitoring
- Replacement Filter Subscriptions
- HSA/FSA Eligible
- Wildfire Smoke Removal
- Allergy & Asthma Relief
- Designer Customization Panels
- Air Quality Monitor with Bluetooth
- CADR & CFM Ratings
- VOC Removal
- Tower & Compact Models
- Bundle Deals
